name: firecrawl
description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API.
one_liner: A single API that turns the open web into clean, structured data your AI agent can read — scraping and searching across hundreds of sites without you building a scraper for each one.
buyer: A product manager at a startup building an AI research or shopping-comparison app who needs reliable web data but doesn't want to build and maintain scrapers.
business_use_cases: A market-research startup builds a competitor price-tracking product for e-commerce brands on top of its API.
An AI chatbot vendor uses it so their assistant can answer questions with live, current web content instead of stale training data.
A lead-generation agency scrapes public company data at scale to build enriched prospect lists for sales teams.

money_ideas.idea: A managed scraping service built on top, billed per request
A vertical SaaS, such as price monitoring, built on top and sold monthly

steal_this: Build a one-page 'track my competitor's prices daily' tool for a single local retailer this weekend using its API.
